# color-map

> Parse, convert, mix and serialize every CSS color, check WCAG 2 contrast, and build scales, semantic palettes and design tokens from one brand color. One package holds a TypeScript library, the `color-map` command and an agent skill.

This file is generated by `scripts/generate-llms-txt.mjs` from the package exports and the command table. Do not edit it.

Conventions that hold for the library:

- No runtime dependencies, and `"sideEffects": false`, so a bundler keeps only what you import.
- `color-map` re-exports `color-map/color`, `color-map/palette`, `color-map/scale` and `color-map/tokens`. Without a bundler it loads every module, so import from a subpath to load less.
- `Color` is `{ colorSpace, components, alpha? }`. A color as plain JSON. Component ranges follow CSS: `srgb` is 0 to 1, `hsl` and `hwb` take hue in degrees and the rest in 0 to 100, `lab` and `lch` take L in 0 to 100, `oklab` and `oklch` take L in 0 to 1. A missing `alpha` is 1. `Component` is `number | null`. A component value. `null` stands for the CSS keyword `none`.
- `deltaEOK`, `equals`, `contrast`, `findContrast`, `meets`, `onColor`, `inGamut`, `toGamut`, `mix` and `toHex` each have a narrow form named `create` plus the name. It takes the spaces your colors are in and returns the helper over just those, so a bundle does not carry all 15 spaces. `createConverter` does the same for `convert`.
- `contrast`, `findContrast`, `meets`, `onColor` and `mix` also take a CSS color string; the other helpers above take a `Color`, so run strings through `parse` first. Every narrow form takes `Color` objects only.

Conventions that hold for every command:

- Output is TOON on stdout by default; `--format json` gives JSON. Diagnostics go to stderr.
- Colors are any CSS color string, including `color-mix()` and relative colors.
- Contrast is WCAG 2. There is no other contrast algorithm.
- `--full` adds every field. Empty results say so explicitly.
- A failure exits 1 or 2 with `error`, `code` and `help` fields on stdout. Nothing prompts; unknown options fail.
- Run it with `npx color-map <command>`, or install the `color-map` agent skill from this package.

## Library

- [color-map](https://cyberuni.github.io/color-map/library/): re-exports `color-map/color`, `color-map/palette`, `color-map/scale` and `color-map/tokens`. It also exports `Alpha`, `ColorMap`, `createColors`, `createColorsFromMap`, `RGB`, `RGBA`, `rgbaString`, `rgbHex`, deprecated: import them from `color-map/legacy`.
- [color-map/color](https://cyberuni.github.io/color-map/library/#color-mapcolor): `a98Rgb`, `contrast`, `convert`, `convertComponents`, `createContrast`, `createConverter`, `createDeltaEOK`, `createEquals`, `createFindContrast`, `createInGamut`, `createMeets`, `createMix`, `createOnColor`, `createToGamut`, `createToHex`, `deltaEOK`, `displayP3`, `displayP3Linear`, `equals`, `findContrast`, `fromArgb`, `hsl`, `hwb`, `inGamut`, `lab`, `lch`, `meets`, `mix`, `oklab`, `oklch`, `onColor`, `parse`, `parseExpr`, `prophotoRgb`, `rec2020`, `resolve`, `spaces`, `srgb`, `srgbLinear`, `toArgb`, `toCss`, `toGamut`, `toHex`, `wcag2`, `xyzD50`, `xyzD65`. Types: `Color`, `ColorExpr`, `ColorSpaceId`, `Component`, `ContrastAlgorithm`, `ContrastFn`, `ContrastOption`, `FindContrastOptions`, `FoundContrast`, `GamutId`, `HueMethod`, `MixOptions`, `OnColorOptions`, `ResolveContext`, `Space`, `ToCssOptions`, `ToGamutOptions`, `Vec3`.
- [color-map/legacy](https://cyberuni.github.io/color-map/library/#color-maplegacy): `createColors`, `createColorsFromMap`, `rgbaString`, `rgbHex`. Types: `Alpha`, `ColorMap`, `RGB`, `RGBA`.
- [color-map/palette](https://cyberuni.github.io/color-map/library/#color-mappalette): `darkVariant`, `harmonize`, `harmony`, `inverse`, `semanticPalette`, `validate`. Types: `DarkStrategy`, `DarkVariantOptions`, `HarmonizeOptions`, `HarmonyOptions`, `HarmonyScheme`, `HarmonySpace`, `PaletteIssue`, `PaletteLike`, `RolePair`, `SemanticPalette`, `SemanticPaletteOptions`, `SemanticRole`, `ValidateOptions`, `ValidateResult`.
- [color-map/scale](https://cyberuni.github.io/color-map/library/#color-mapscale): `createContrastScale`, `createGradient`, `createScale`, `lstar`, `MATERIAL_TONES`, `scaleFromBrand`, `tonalPalette`, `toneColor`. Types: `BrandScaleOptions`, `ContrastScaleOptions`, `ContrastStep`, `GradientOptions`, `GradientStop`, `ScaleOptions`, `ScalePreset`, `TonalPaletteOptions`.
- [color-map/tokens](https://cyberuni.github.io/color-map/library/#color-maptokens): `toCssVariables`, `toDTCG`, `toDtcgValue`, `toTailwindTheme`. Types: `CssVariablesOptions`, `DtcgColorValue`, `DtcgGroup`, `DtcgOptions`, `DtcgToken`, `TailwindThemeOptions`, `TokenTree`.

## Commands

- [convert](https://unpkg.com/color-map/schemas/convert.schema.json): Convert a CSS color to another color space. Usage: `color-map convert <color>` with --to, --gamut, --full.
- [mix](https://unpkg.com/color-map/schemas/mix.schema.json): Mix two CSS colors, as color-mix() does. Usage: `color-map mix <a> <b>` with --amount, --in, --hue, --full.
- [contrast](https://unpkg.com/color-map/schemas/contrast.schema.json): WCAG 2 contrast ratio of a text color on a background, with the AA and AAA verdicts. Usage: `color-map contrast <fg> <bg>` with no options.
- [find-contrast](https://unpkg.com/color-map/schemas/find-contrast.schema.json): Find the color closest in lightness to a background that reaches a WCAG 2 contrast target. Usage: `color-map find-contrast <bg>` with --target, --hue, --chroma, --direction, --full.
- [scale](https://unpkg.com/color-map/schemas/scale.schema.json): Build a color scale from a seed color: a preset, a Radix-style brand scale, or contrast targets. Usage: `color-map scale <seed>` with --preset, --steps, --brand, --mode, --background, --targets, --gamut, --full.
- [palette](https://unpkg.com/color-map/schemas/palette.schema.json): A semantic palette from one brand color: primary, status colors, surface and outline, each with a text color and its WCAG 2 ratio. Usage: `color-map palette <brand>` with --mode, --target, --gamut, --full.
- [harmony](https://unpkg.com/color-map/schemas/harmony.schema.json): The colors of a harmony scheme: the color rotated around the hue wheel. Usage: `color-map harmony <color>` with --scheme, --space, --gamut.
- [export](https://unpkg.com/color-map/schemas/export.schema.json): Write a palette, a scale or your own tokens as DTCG JSON, CSS variables or a Tailwind v4 theme. Usage: `color-map export [color]` with --to, --source, --mode, --tokens, --space, --prefix, --selector, --namespace, --inline, --precision, --hex.
- [schema](https://cyberuni.github.io/color-map/cli/#machine-readable-help): Print the JSON Schema of a command's arguments and options. Usage: `color-map schema [command]` with no options.
